annotations.text:
Read left to right, top to bottom: reference principles, five concepts, the two that survive, the recommendation, the asset system, then the mark in use.

The recommended direction is QUARTER - a ring with one quadrant stepped out along the diagonal. Everything on boards 05 and 06 is drawn from that one construction.

The reference was used for principles only: restraint, a single-operation mark, cap-line alignment, monochrome first. None of its shapes, letterforms or proportions are carried across.

To fill in: the studio domain (shown as [quarix.com] on the business card). The wordmark is set in Geist, the same family the Quarix site already loads - swap it if you license a different face.
